blockers.finding: The Pokémon TCG Official logo overlaps the EXPANSIONS navigation item on both the 390x844 proof surface and the 1440 outer viewport with the narrow internal phone.
blockers.acceptanceViolated: logo, official front/back card, CTA, and carousel do not overlap

warnings.finding: The loaded page contains prefers-reduced-motion rules, but the selected browser reported matchMedia=false and exposed no media emulation. Actual reduce-mode computed behavior was therefore not independently exercised. This cannot be promoted from rule-presence evidence to a verified runtime PASS.
The second carousel state changes the Hero variant but reuses the same campaign logo and featured card; it is functional but is a weak demonstration of distinct campaign continuity.

visibilityAndReadability.notes: Hero and next-section typography are readable, but the top logo/navigation collision is immediately visible and makes the navigation header look compressed.

officialAssetsAndBrandLayers.notes: Official background, campaign mark, TCG logo, card front and card back all load. The TCG logo placement collides with navigation.

compactComposition.notes: Hero height is 415.994px, below the 430px allowance; the following section begins immediately and is visible in the first viewport. The composition reads as a designed compact Hero rather than a uniformly shrunken desktop screenshot.

cardFlip.notes: Pointer and keyboard interactions both complete front-to-back-to-front. CSS rotateY is present. Card bounds, phone scrollTop and Hero overflow remain stable through the captured transition midpoint.

reducedMotion.notes: Media rules are loaded, but reduce-mode was not active and could not be emulated on this proof surface.

carousel.notes: 0-to-1-to-0 works and all states remain nonblank; second-state content differentiation is limited.

responsiveGeometry.notes: No document or Hero horizontal overflow. The 1440 outer viewport still renders the compact internal-phone rule at 415.994px Hero height.

console.notes: No warning or error entries were observed.

hostTransferability.notes: The 50vh-style compact direction is viable and branded, but the header collision prevents this build from being accepted as a reusable host-ready recipe.

requiredCorrection: Give the TCG logo and campaign navigation non-overlapping responsive regions on the compact internal-phone surface, then rerun a fresh Blind QA. Do not solve it by shrinking either item below readability or removing the preserved logo.
